findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 60.6% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 53.0% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: 11 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 49 top-holder wallets resolve to 11 linked groups holding 58.7% of supply. The largest (2 wallets) holds 43.0%.

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 0.10% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $3,826,938 this week, far outpacing proven traders.

findings.title: Smart Money is accumulating
findings.detail: 30 Smart Money wallets hold 5.3% of supply, up 0.80% in 30 days.
